qa_pairs.question: What fuse should be checked first when troubleshooting A/C blower issues?
What happens when the Blower Speed Control is moved to position 4?
qa_pairs.answer: When the Blower Speed Control is moved to position 4, battery voltage is applied directly to the Blower Motor, which then runs at maximum speed.

qa_pairs.question: What type of motor is the Blower Motor?
qa_pairs.answer: The Blower Motor is a variable speed motor which runs at a speed proportional to the voltage applied to it.

qa_pairs.question: What should you do if the blower will only run in high speed?
qa_pairs.answer: If Blower will run in high only, check the Blower Resistors' Safety Switch for an open.

qa_pairs.question: What test should be performed if the symptom is 'Blower Motor does not run in any speed setting'?
qa_pairs.answer: Do Test B if the Blower Motor does not run in any speed setting.

qa_pairs.question: What voltage should be measured between terminals 4 (GN/BR) & Ground during the Blower Speed Control Test?
qa_pairs.answer: Battery voltage should be measured between terminals 4 (GN/BR) & Ground.

qa_pairs.question: What are the required conditions for Test A: Control Switch Voltage Test?
qa_pairs.answer: The conditions are: Ignition Switch: RUN and Blower Speed Control: OFF.

qa_pairs.question: What voltage should be present between terminals 7 (YL) & Ground when A/C Select Switch is OFF?
qa_pairs.answer: 0 Volts should be present between terminals 7 (YL) & Ground when A/C Select Switch is OFF (Not Depressed).

qa_pairs.question: Why do the Blower Resistors dissipate heat?
qa_pairs.answer: The Blower Resistors dissipate heat because of the current flowing through them. They are cooled by the air flow from the Blower.

qa_pairs.question: What happens if there is insufficient air flow to cool the Resistors?
qa_pairs.answer: If there is insufficient air flow to cool the Resistors, the Safety Switch will open, shutting the Blower Motor off until the Resistors have cooled.

qa_pairs.question: What test should be done if the A/C Select Switch or Fresh/Recirculating Air Switch does not light?
qa_pairs.answer: Do Test A if the A/C Select Switch or Fresh/Recirculating Air Switch does not light.

qa_pairs.question: What are the conditions required for Test B: Blower Speed Control Test?
qa_pairs.answer: The conditions are: Ignition Switch: RUN, A/C Select Switch: ON (Depressed), and Fresh/Recirculating Air Switch: FRESH (Not Depressed).
